title: [Core v2][W40 Blocker] Safe pre-Architecture supersession of accepted Evidence/Materiality at EVIDENCE_REVIEWED
body:
## Problem / affected production

J-GAS W40 branch `weekly/2026-W40-v2-work`, reviewed Muse r11 HEAD `5b63d0c9f49610996658afbe072f5c996a92ddb5`, Tree `0c6c67c9a4ef4feeddc23c06e06205c75b43587f`; reviewed main `afdb3df3faa20af3bb5798be429bba8dbd2100b1`. Canonical stage `EVIDENCE_REVIEWED`, Selection and Human Gates pending.

Two already-discovered and evidenced W40 technical announcements were originally marked `TIME_UNRESOLVED/HOLD`, but the original issuer-authored Hugging Face organization articles carry dated hosting platform JSON-LD within W40:
- Ai2 / AstaBrief `https://huggingface.co/blog/allenai/astabrief`: `datePublished=2026-10-02T15:19:50.340Z`.
- ServiceNow CoreAI / AutoSynthData `https://huggingface.co/blog/ServiceNow-AI/autosynthdata`: `datePublished=2026-10-02T04:01:31.290Z`.

These timestamps establish *issuer-authored article publication*, not the first instant weight/code/dataset artifacts became downloadable. Both are technically material methods announcements, but canonical Edition Views + Materiality still mark HOLD and Core Selection validator rejects selecting HOLD.

Existing `scripts/survey_production_v2.py::transition_state()` is forward-only; `scripts/survey_human_gate_v2.py::invalidate_pending_gate()` is applicable only at a reached pending Human Gate and requires Architecture checkpoint PASSED for Architecture Review. At `EVIDENCE_REVIEWED`, neither is a legal path for upstream Evidence/View/Materiality correction. **Do not** manually rewrite Production State, mutate immutable prior Acceptance, spoof Human Gate input or repurpose pending-Gate invalidation.

W40 read-only feasibility report:
https://github.com/eariver/japanese-generative-ai-survey/blob/5b63d0c9f49610996658afbe072f5c996a92ddb5/sources/2026-W40/execution/core-reentry-feasibility-r11.md

## Requested bounded Core enhancement / acceptance contract

Implement a **reviewed** operation for same-state, pre-Architecture *upstream authority supersession* after `EVIDENCE_REVIEWED`. Requirements:

1. Only when current Stage == `EVIDENCE_REVIEWED`, Selection/Architecture pending, both Human Gates pending with null review provenance; an explicit independently recorded Sol scope decision must be provided.
2. Fail-closed remote branch HEAD/Tree and reviewed main/Core implementation SHA guards, exact base `checkpoint_provenance`, old acceptance Sha and changed ID allowlist; never force push or reset.
3. Preserve all old accepted bytes and SHA traceability; create immutable **versioned** new accepts/materiality/completeness and one append-only supersession record with old→new authority hashes and reviewer decision.
4. New official Evidence/Card source authority must include the original hosted issuer articles and preserve original Discovery/Screening provenance. **First determine whether the already accepted `INSPECT` Screening decisions permit correct new Evidence/Views/Materiality**: `survey_architecture_v2_base.py::derive_candidate_matrix` derives from Evidence/View/Materiality and `validate_selection` rejects HOLD materiality, but does not directly test a KEEP Screening decision. Avoid unnecessary 37-Discovery/37-Screening regeneration if the documented Core semantics allow retaining INSPECT while promoting newly verified Materiality; if a canonical Screening change is required by the precise governance contract, document and SHA-guard it explicitly.
5. Revalidate all 35 Evidence/Card ↔ View mappings, 37-row Ledger, Completeness, Matrix/Selection preview, item-level timestamps and source roles. State remains `EVIDENCE_REVIEWED`; selection must not advance until independent Sol review approves the supersession.
6. Negative tests: stale HEAD/SHA, unauthorized candidate ID, human review present, stage beyond evidence, bad source pub timestamp, missing original source/hash, failed validators, incongruent Evidence/View status, forced backward transition, and idempotent replay. Test on Weekly and another profile without changing unrelated edition authority.
7. Implement in a **separately authorized existing Core maintenance branch**, reviewed/merged to main by normal PR process. No new branch under an implicit W40 execution authority; no shared Core hotfix directly on W40.

## Source and editorial decision

Muse r11 original-host ledger:
https://github.com/eariver/japanese-generative-ai-survey/blob/5b63d0c9f49610996658afbe072f5c996a92ddb5/sources/2026-W40/execution/host-timestamp-ledger-r11.md

Muse r11 Plan A vs Plan B:
https://github.com/eariver/japanese-generative-ai-survey/blob/5b63d0c9f49610996658afbe072f5c996a92ddb5/sources/2026-W40/execution/selection/selection-counterfactual-r11.md

Recommendation to Sol: Plan B, **both are in-window issuer-authored announcements, provisional MATERIAL**, with exact Selection PRIMARY/SUPPORTING roles reviewed after Core reconciliation. AstaBrief model artifact creation predates the October article and AutoSynthData has no verified standalone public implementation; do not misstate either.

Linked to existing deferred Core issue CV2-DM-016 only by broad source-authorization workflow; this supersession defect is **distinct** from the Evidence `source_type` taxonomy mismatch.
